maria: Heads-up — opened a docs PR for streaming + pagination snippets (py/ts/go). Need quick sanity checks on retry logic and resume token usage. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432

alex: Looking now. Which files changed?

maria: Changed: docs/snippets/streaming_py.md, streaming_ts.md, streaming_go.md. Py adds async generator example, TS adds readable stream + iterator, Go adds StreamClient example. Main concerns: retry/backoff example, and we removed the old 'cursor' header in favor of 'resume_token' — need to reflect that.

kevin: Can you paste the py snippet here? I'll run it locally.

maria: ```python
# simplified snippet for streaming with retries
from redwood import Client, RetryableError
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

client = Client()

async def stream_with_retries(prompt):
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            async for chunk in client.stream(prompt, max_retries=0):
                yield chunk
            break
        except RetryableError:
            await asyncio.sleep(2 ** attempt)
            continue
```

sophia: Nit: don't show swallowing RetryableError without an explanation. Recommend using our retry utility or tenacity and show max_retries param. Also show how to propagate cancellation (asyncio.CancelledError).

maria: Good point — I'll replace the naive loop with our retry util and add a short note on cancellation + resume_token.

alex: For TS we should show both a readable stream example and an async iterator example, plus a tiny helper to map cursor->resume_token for the migration doc. I'll draft that.

kevin: For Go: current snippet uses goroutines + channels. Make sure context cancellation is handled and document that StreamResponse.ResumeToken replaces Cursor. I'll open a quick PR against the branch.

dev-docs-bot: CI: docs lint passed ✅, snippets/test failed on streaming_ts.md — error: "UnhandledPromiseRejectionWarning: missing await on stream.read()" (line 48)

maria: Thanks CI. I'll fix the TS snippet await.

sophia: I'll review TS + Go in ~1h, can also check the pagination migration section (we added a 'resume examples' section).

kevin: :thumbsup:

maria: If someone can approve before EOD I'll merge and backport to v0.12.x. I also want a quick note added to the migration guide: "If you relied on cursor header, switch to resume_token in response metadata and use client.resume(resume_token) to continue."

alex: Added a tiny unit test for the ts snippet that mocks a 502 retry and checks backoff. Pushed to your branch.

maria: Awesome — summary of follow-ups: 1) swap py loop for retry util + cancellation example, 2) fix TS await + add iterator/readable examples + test, 3) go: add ctx cancel handling + resume_token example, 4) migration guide blurb. I'll update PR now and ping reviewers.

dev-docs-bot: PR update detected, snippets/test rerun queued.

maria: Thanks all — ping if you spot anything else after the patch.
